summary: Brand mass actions (/marcas) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed for POST /api/marcas/mass-action (403 for a user without the special function, 400 for tipo_servicio/unknown action/empty ids/invalid segment/invalid group/bad confirm, segment inheritance honoring inherit_overrides incl. branch, categoria, ejecutivo, coord_impl, integrador, group propagation to RIFs and branches, delete empty + skip brand with RIF). UI (admin): brand-mass-bar, disabled button with no selection, select-all and per-row selection, counter, all 7 actions present (no tipo_servicio), segment dialog with inherit note, applied from UI and verified in DB (RIF with 'segment' override kept 'Mixto'), group applied from UI and verified in DB, delete shows processed=1 and mass-result-skipped lists the brand with RIF. Non-permission user (jdolande): no mass bar or checkboxes. Regression on /clients: 8 actions incl. group_brand, segment dialog opens, no brand note. All test data was isolated TEST_376 groups/brands/clients and was cleaned up; no real data was touched.

minor.issue: brand_ids that do not exist are silently ignored: processed can be lower than the number selected and skipped does not say why.
Only counts principal RIFs (is_branch != True). It does not check branches that have marca_id or other references (quotes/projects with marca_id). The brand's contacts are deleted without a warning.

critical_code_review_comments: brands_mass_action runs propagate_brand one brand at a time with no batching. With up to 3000 brands, each with many RIFs, the request could take a long time. Consider a background job or bulk_write.
skipped entries reuse the key 'client_id' to hold the brand_id. It works with the shared dialog but the naming is misleading.
No audit or history record is written for mass changes to brands (same as clients mass-action). Consider logging who changed what.
seed_data_creation: Isolated fixture: grp_test376_a/b, brd_test376_1/2/empty, cli_test376_r1 (+ branch r1s), r2 (segment override 'Mixto'), r3. Created with 'setup' and removed with 'cleanup' (verified 0 remaining).
